concepts.title: Workers, Workforce and Labour Force
concepts.definition: A worker is any person engaged in an economic activity, the workforce is the number of persons actually working, and the labour force equals the workforce plus the unemployed who are seeking work; labour force participation rate is the labour force as a percentage of the population.
concepts.key_idea: The workforce participation rate divides the workforce by the population, showing how many of hundred persons are working.
question_patterns: define worker workforce and labour force
calculate the unemployment rate from the given data
what is the workforce participation rate
who counts as a worker in economics
compute the participation rate of a population

solution_steps.action: take unemployed as share of labour force
solution_steps.explain: Divide the number of unemployed persons by the labour force and multiply by 100 to get the unemployment rate

concepts.title: Types of Unemployment: Rural and Urban
concepts.definition: Rural areas show seasonal unemployment in agriculture and disguised unemployment where extra workers do not add to output, while urban areas show educated unemployment among degree holders, and unemployment harms both the individual and the economy's output.
concepts.key_idea: Disguised unemployment means removal of some workers leaves output unchanged, a common feature of crowded Indian farms.

what is educated unemployment in urban areas

state the ill effects of unemployment

solution_steps.explain: Note rural or urban context of the joblessness.
Identify seasonal, disguised, open or educated unemployment.
Describe the loss to the person and the economy.

concepts.title: Formal and Informal Employment; Jobless Growth Issues
concepts.definition: Formal employment carries written contract, regular salary and social security benefits, while informal employment lacks such protection and dominates Indian employment; the share of formal sector is small and jobless growth raises concern since output rises without matching employment.
concepts.key_idea: Only about half the workforce receives social security, so extending formality to informal workers is a policy challenge.

solution_steps.explain: Look for written contract, salary and social security.
